'''Eye-snatchers''' were predatory red-feathered birds native to the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]]. Their nests were raided for their edible [[Egg/Legends|eggs]], which resembled [[eye]]balls. Attempting to rescue their stolen eggs, the birds would often mistake [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] eyes for the pilfered eggs, and snatch up thieves' eyeballs by plucking them out with their talons. The bumbling [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] cyclops giant [[Gondry]] was one such unfortunate being.<ref name="Capture Arawynne" />

The [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] kept eye-snatchers in her luxurious if notorious [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]], within her [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|palace]] near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="Capture Arawynne" />
